reported.quote: Since FY 2017-18 we have more than doubled our store count to 324 despite the outbreak of the pandemic in 2020.
We expanded our store presence and successfully opened 40 new stores during FY22-23.

business: Avenue Supermarts Limited operates retail supermarkets under the DMart brand, selling a wide range of grocery, FMCG, and daily essential products through physical stores as well as online via DMart Ready. The company focuses on a cluster-based expansion strategy across large and small towns.
